强制横屏（宽屏铺满，适合看剧、玩游戏）: Force landscape (Widescreen fill, suitable for videos and games)
打开（推荐 · 逻辑密度 190dpi，sw606dp 走平板排版）: On (Recommended · Logical density 190dpi, sw606dp tablet layout)
720 宽按 190dpi 算等于 606dp，正好越过 Android 的 6: 720 width at 190dpi equals 606dp, passing Android's 600dp tablet breakpoint; dual-column views and split settings appear only in this layout. Turning off reverts to phone layout (larger text, less information). Changes take effect on next app launch.
微软商店版无法安装内核驱动。请到「启用或关闭 Windows 功能」里勾选「虚拟: Microsoft Store edition cannot install kernel drivers. Please enable "Virtual Machine Platform" and "Windows Hypervisor Platform" in "Turn Windows features on or off", restart your PC, and ApkStart will automatically use Hyper-V.
下次打开应用时会按应用自己的方向选面板，方向不一致的话会重启一次运行时。: Next time an app opens, the orientation will match the app. If different, the runtime will restart once.
下次打开应用时会重启一次运行时把面板切到指定方向，之后不再重启。: Next time an app opens, the runtime will restart once to switch to the specified orientation.
下次打开应用时生效（会重启一次运行时来改逻辑密度）。: Takes effect on next app launch (restarts runtime once to change logical density).
首次启动 · 本地准备中（无需联网）: First launch · Local setup in progress (no network required)
运行时组件已随安装包内置，不再下载任何东西: Runtime components are bundled with the installer; no further downloads required
把系统镜像展开到用户目录（约 1 分钟，只需一次）: Extracting system image to user directory (~1 minute, one-time only)
准备硬件加速与输入法: Preparing hardware acceleration and input method
完成后双击 APK 或桌面图标即可秒开应用: Once completed, double-click an APK or desktop icon to launch apps instantly
微软商店版无法安装内核驱动。请到「启用或关闭 Windows 功能」里勾选「虚拟: Microsoft Store edition cannot install kernel drivers. Please enable "Virtual Machine Platform" and "Windows Hypervisor Platform" under "Turn Windows features on or off". After restarting your PC, ApkStart will automatically use WHPX hardware acceleration.
第二次打开应用只要几秒，占用约 2–3 GB 磁盘空间。: Launches apps in seconds after first run; uses ~2–3 GB disk space.
留空使用默认位置: Leave blank to use default location
收敛 vCPU 配额并降低进程优先级，CPU 优先让给 Windows 桌面。: Limits vCPU quota and lowers process priority; gives CPU precedence to Windows desktop.
禁用非必需后台服务，只保留应用运行环境。: Disables non-essential background services; keeps only the app runtime environment.
启动 ApkStart 后后台引导安卓环境，点开应用即可秒进。: Pre-boots the Android environment in the background so apps launch instantly.
自带输入法支持。: Built-in keyboard and input method support.
为安卓系统配置快速公共 DNS 解析。: Configures fast public DNS resolution for the Android system.
让应用提示音与媒体音频正常播放。: Enables app notification sounds and media audio playback.
高级引擎参数（一般无需修改）: Advanced Engine Parameters (Usually no changes needed)
开启后右键只执行返回，不再触发点击。: When enabled, right click only performs Back and will not trigger a tap.
仅在前台窗口生效，不影响桌面操作。: Only active when the app window is in the foreground; does not affect desktop use.
把按键映射成安卓触屏点击/滑动。: Maps keyboard keys to Android touch taps and swipes.
双击 APK 直接安装到 ApkStart: Double-click APK files to install directly into ApkStart
获取最新版本并自动平滑更新。: Checks for the latest version and applies updates smoothly and automatically.
